## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Validation

- [ ] `composer check` passes locally
- [ ] Behavior-changing code has tests, or the PR explains why tests are not applicable
- [ ] Installable package still builds with `bash scripts/build-zip.sh`

## Compatibility

List relevant WordPress, WooCommerce, PHP, HPOS, Blocks, or WP-CLI considerations.

## Diagnostic safety

- [ ] No credentials, authentication material, customer/order data, or absolute filesystem paths are added to reports
- [ ] New warnings describe an actionable signal and avoid claiming that a site is broken without evidence
